title: Assessment of Cortical Plasticity Following Short Term Limb Immobility
brief_summary: The proposed project will study the consequence of short term limb immobility on the patterns of brain activity using functional imaging (fMRI)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* wrist fracture.
* Fit for MRI scanning.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unwillingness to sign informed consent.
* Neurological disease
* s/p fractures
